title: Tell the owner about each payment received
summary: When a customer pays, by a payment page or a transfer to their account number, tell the owner and log it in a sheet.
description: Whenever your payments account reports money received (a customer paying a payment page, or a bank transfer from a customer), tells the owner who paid and how much, and adds a row to a Google Sheet: date, reference, payer and amount. Works with Paystack, Moniepoint or Flutterwave; the owner hears on the WhatsApp or Telegram they linked to Taskiem, or by email.
